You will explore new ways of using generative AI to manage and write computer programs, revolutionizing software development and enhancing efficiency. With your determination and resilience, our faculty and staff will provide you with the knowledge and skills needed to make your mark in this dynamic landscape. At ICT Mahidol, you'll benefit from world-class facilities, including advanced computing infrastructure, an IoT lab, and a state-of-the-art cybersecurity SOC. These resources will ensure you gain hands-on experience with the tools and technologies shaping our future. You will also have opportunities to participate in internships with prestigious university partners like the University of Bremen (Germany), National Central University (Taiwan), National Institute of Advanced Industrial Science and Technology (Japan), Nara Institute of Science and Technology (Japan), Japan Advance Institute of Science and Technology (Japan), Osaka University (Japan), Tokyo City University (Japan), Tokyo University of Agriculture and Technology (Japan), Ritsumeikan University (Japan), and University of Sydney (Australia), as well as with local and international companies, enhancing your practical skills and professional network. Studying computer science is a journey that requires your devotion, attention to all your classes, and engagement with your friends, faculty, and staff to achieve your educational objectives. Your educational success will be a strong foundation for a good life, extending benefits to your family, society, and the world, following the words of Prince Mahidol: “True success is not in the learning but in its application to the benefit of mankind.”
Besides your academic pursuits, you'll forge lifelong friendships and enjoy a vibrant campus life filled with exciting activities in our well-equipped ICT building.

By remaining globally aware and staying abreast of new academic discoveries and technologies worldwide, Mahidol University continues not only to meet the needs of Thailand for education, training and research, but through internationalization, the needs of the global community as well. Welcome to the Faculty of Information and Communication Technology

The Faculty of Information and Communication Technology (ICT), Mahidol University (MUICT) was established in 2009 to cope with the rapid change of education and technology landscape of the world towards digital era and industry 4.0. Following Mahidol University guiding principles, the Faculty of ICT aims to provide higher education with the vision to be a united institution focusing on student in order to provide knowledge and capability suitable to the rising demands in the industry and society including computer science, cyber technology, and game technology with the computer science foundation focus on data analytics and data science, artificial intelligence, software engineering, cyber security, industrial automation, and the Internet of Things. The strategic plans of the Faculty of ICT consist of the followings:
Building globally competent, lifelong, digital learners
Striving for excellence in research and innovation in computing technology
Providing response customer-centric computing technology services
Creating sustainable and effective organization
Fostering national culture, identity, and art using computing technology

The Faculty of ICT currently (in 2024) offers 6 degree programs including
Bachelor of Science in Digital Science and Technology (DST)
Bachelor of Science in Information and Communication Technology (ICT)
Master of Science in Computer Science (MCS)
Master of Science in Cyber Security and Information Assurance (MCY)
Master of Science in Game Technology (MGT)
Doctor of Philosophy in Computer Science (DCS)

The Faculty of ICT is proud of its faculty members and students.

Building globally competent, lifelong, digital learners

The Faculty of ICT currently (in 2024) offers 6 degree programs including
Bachelor of Science in Digital Science and Technology (DST)
Bachelor of Science in Information and Communication Technology (ICT)
Master of Science in Computer Science (MCS)
Master of Science in Cyber Security and Information Assurance (MCY)
Master of Science in Game Technology (MGT)
Doctor of Philosophy in Computer Science (DCS)

The Faculty of ICT is proud of its faculty members and students. Most faculty members graduate from top universities around the world. Established in 2009, The Faculty of Information and Communication Technology is one of the newest faculties of Mahidol University. The Faculty of Information and Communication Technology, established in 2009, is one of the newest faculties of Mahidol University. It stemmed from the Department of Computer Science, Faculty of Science and the Computing Center that cooperated for several academic achievements, software development for university administration, and computing research since 1988. Recognizing the significance of information and communication technology development in Thailand, Mahidol University established the Faculty of ICT with the mission to meet the growing domestic needs for qualified human resources in computer technology. reasoning_steps.question: What field does the faculty of ICT conduct research in?
reasoning_steps.context: The faculty members in the Faculty of ICT conduct research in major areas of computer science including but not limited to software engineering, database management, artificial intelligence, computer networks, cyber security, internet of things, and data science (see research clusters). The degree of Doctor of Philosophy requires a dissertation based on the candidate’s original research, which is supervised by a faculty member, and all students in the Ph.D. program are actively engaged in research throughout the program. Ph.D. students spend at least half of their time on research under the direction of their faculty adviser from their first day in the program and devote themselves full time to research after coursework and qualifying exam have been completed. Ph.D. students are also expected to participate in faculty and university activities full time on campus throughout the program, except possibly for academic exchange or internships elsewhere. The Ph.D. in Computer Science program is a three-year program. The candidate is required to have strong knowledge and skills in computer science or related areas in order to be admitted to the program. Research and innovation in computer science and information technology are important for the advancement of the digital industries today to help drive the country forward.

Master of Science in Game Technology and Gamification  (International Program – Special Program)

Philosophy of the Program
The game industry is larger than both Hollywood and the music industry. Vast opportunities lie ahead for those with the right knowledge, skills, and experiences. Our primary goal is to equip students with the foundation necessary for tapping into these exciting opportunities. Additionally, the Thai game industry has been dominated by imports. We aim to address this problem by producing a capable workforce that is globally competitive. Objectives of the Program
To educate students such that upon their graduation, they will:
Excel in theories, practices, and research of game technology and gamification. Be capable of developing solutions and innovations using game technology and gamification for the benefits of society. Adhere to ethics, integrity, discipline, and have respect for the rights of other people and intellectual properties. Effectively communicate in English, be proficient in the use of information technology, and possess creativity, leadership and teamwork. Language
English is the medium of communication. Duration of Study
This is a two-year program, with the flexibility for faster graduation. The program is designed to accommodate both inexperienced and exceptional students.
